notes: CR 616.1: seat 1 controls Fiery Emancipation and Shocks seat 0, who controls Nine Lives. Both replacements apply to the 2 damage to seat 0, so seat 0 (the affected player) chooses. It picks Fiery Emancipation first: the damage becomes 6; Nine Lives still applies (616.1f) and prevents it, putting one incarnation counter on itself. Seat 0 stays at 20. This is the B-69 crash pair (Nine Lives with Fiery Emancipation, eval deal 900137), which raised NotImplementedError before the fix.
